gridTemplateColumnsHelp.title: Grid template columns
gridTemplateColumnsHelp.description: A CSS grid-template-columns value: one size expression per column track, separated by spaces. Use fr for flexible shares, px or rem for fixed widths, and minmax(min, max) to set bounds. repeat(n, size) expands n identical tracks. Layout columns controls how many track rows exist; this field sets each track's width. Prefer minmax(0, …fr) on flexible tracks to avoid overflow.
gridTemplateColumnsHelp.example: minmax(500px, 600px) repeat(3, 200px) — one flexible hero column plus three fixed 200px columns

formulas.annuityPayment: Fixed payment for equal installments (French amortization)
formulas.annuityPaymentDetail1: Uses principal, rate per period, and number of periods
formulas.simpleInterest: Simple interest for one period (amount × rate)
formulas.simpleInterestDetail1: No compounding — interest is calculated on the original amount only
formulas.monthlyRateFromQuote: Convert quoted bank rate (EA/NA/NMV) to monthly decimal
formulas.monthlyRateFromQuoteDetail1: EA (effective annual) is converted using compound monthly formula
formulas.monthlyRateFromQuoteDetail2: NA and NMV use their respective conversion rules
formulas.scheduleAnchorDate: Pick the schedule start date from origination or next due
formulas.scheduleAnchorDateDetail1: Uses originationDate when set, otherwise falls back to nextDueDate
formulas.loanOriginationDate: Resolve the loan origination date from terms or current record
formulas.loanScheduleAnchorDate: Resolve the loan schedule anchor date
formulas.loanScheduleAnchorDateDetail1: Uses origination date or parent next due date as anchor
formulas.loanCoalescePrincipal: Resolve opening principal from original or parent balance
formulas.loanBasePrincipal: Resolve opening principal from origination anchor
formulas.loanBasePrincipalDetail1: Uses loanCoalescePrincipal when origination date is set
formulas.loanPeriodBalance: Opening balance for the current payment period
formulas.loanPeriodBalanceDetail1: Uses loop state remaining balance, or falls back to base principal
formulas.loanTermMonthsDetail1: Read from loanDetails.termMonths on the current record
formulas.loanGermanRemainingTermMonths: German amortization: remaining periods including the current row
formulas.loanGermanUsesStatementAmount: German amortization: first row uses parent statement amount
formulas.loanGermanUsesStatementAmountDetail1: When origination date is missing, loopIndex is 0, and parent amount is set
formulas.loanIsLastPeriod: True when the current loop is on the final payment period
formulas.loanMonthlyRate: Monthly decimal rate from current quote fields
formulas.loanMonthlyRateDetail1: Calls monthlyRateFromQuote with current rate and quote
formulas.loanMonthlyRateDetail2: Used by all loan payment calculations
formulas.loanAnnuityPayment: Fixed French annuity payment amount for the loan
formulas.loanAnnuityPaymentDetail1: Calls platform annuityPayment with principal, rate, and term
formulas.loanAnnuityPaymentDetail2: Used when amortization type is FRENCH
formulas.loanInterestPayment: Interest portion for the current period
formulas.loanInterestPaymentDetail1: Strategy varies by amortization type (French, German, flat)
formulas.loanPrincipalPayment: Principal portion for the current period
formulas.loanPrincipalPaymentDetail1: On the last period, pays off remaining balance
formulas.loanPrincipalPaymentDetail2: Otherwise annuity payment minus interest portion
formulas.schedulePrincipalPortion: Principal portion written to the payment schedule row
formulas.scheduleInterestPortion: Interest portion written to the payment schedule row
formulas.scheduleExpectedAmount: Expected payment amount for the schedule row
formulas.scheduleExpectedAmountDetail1: Sum of principal and interest portions
formulas.amortizationLoopState: Carry remaining balance to the next payment row
formulas.amortizationLoopStateDetail1: Subtracts principal portion from period opening balance
formulas.paymentScheduleFrenchRowCount: Row count for French amortization schedules
formulas.paymentScheduleFrenchRowCountDetail1: Equals loan term in months when annuity payment is valid
formulas.paymentScheduleAmortizedRowCount: Row count based on amortization type
formulas.paymentScheduleAmortizedRowCountDetail1: Routes to French row count or term-based count
formulas.paymentScheduleRowCount: Total payment rows for a loan schedule
formulas.paymentScheduleRowCountDetail1: Considers amortization type, principal, and term
formulas.paymentScheduleDueDate: Due date for a loan payment schedule row
formulas.frequencyStepMultiplier: Period step multiplier for a payment frequency
formulas.frequencyUnit: Date-add unit for a payment frequency
formulas.frequencyUnitDetail1: Maps frequency code to weeks or months
formulas.frequencyDueDate: Due date from base date, frequency, and period index
formulas.frequencyDueDateDetail1: Adds periodIndex × step multiplier to base date
formulas.frequencyDueDateDetail2: Uses frequencyUnit to determine weeks vs months
formulas.frequencyScheduleDueDate: Due dates follow the payment frequency
formulas.frequencyScheduleDueDateDetail1: Starts from the first payment date
formulas.frequencyScheduleDueDateDetail2: Each row steps forward by frequency
formulas.frequencyAdvanceDueDate: Advance due date by one payment period
formulas.frequencyAdvanceDueDateDetail1: Rolls baseDate forward by one frequency step

formulas.inferFlatLoanOriginationDateDetail1: Used for flat/NONE amortization when origination is missing

initial.recurring: Otherwise → up to schedule horizon (max 1000 rows)
